narrative.edge.e1: You move along the walkway above the main pipeline, lights flickering on and off overhead.
narrative.edge.e2: Standing water spreads at your feet as you cross the half-sunken grating.
narrative.edge.e3: This path leads to the Atrium's glass concourse — after the explosion, it won't exist anymore.
narrative.edge.e4: The elevated walkway sways faintly underfoot, the city's lights flickering in the distance.
narrative.edge.e5: You duck into a maintenance tunnel, the dark swallowing and amplifying every sound.
narrative.edge.e6: The pipe gap barely fits one person sideways — whose marks are those on the wall?
narrative.edge.e7: The freight corridor's conveyor has long stopped moving; you step over scattered empty crates.
narrative.edge.r1: You climb down through the warm roots, sap glowing faintly against your hands.
narrative.equip.cloth_jacket: You pull on the rough cloth jacket — better than nothing.
narrative.equip.stab_jacket: The weight of the stab vest settles onto your shoulders, solid.
narrative.equip.composite_chest: The composite chestplate clicks into place like a promise.
narrative.equip.work_helmet: You knock on the work helmet — sturdy enough.
narrative.equip.nvg_helmet: The NVG lenses flicker on, and the dark retreats a step. (Signal +10)
narrative.equip.work_pants: The work pants have deep pockets — room for more.
narrative.equip.gloves: You flex your fingers — the gloves fit well.
narrative.equip.backpack: You swing the backpack onto your shoulders and cinch the straps.

narrative.trait.medic: This run, your hands are unusually steady — dressings go on fast and clean.
narrative.trait.artisan: This run, tools just seem to behave in your hands.
narrative.trait.attuned: This run, you could swear you hear whispers beneath the roots.
narrative.trait.tough: This run, your body feels tough as old bark.
narrative.trait.fleet: This run, your steps land lighter than anyone else's.
narrative.noise.metal: A metallic clang echoes in the distance. (toward {direction})
narrative.noise.faint: A faint sound drifts in from somewhere. (toward {direction})
narrative.injury.combat.leg: Your leg takes a slash — moving grows harder.
narrative.injury.combat.arm: Your arm takes a hit — your aim no longer holds steady.
narrative.downed.self_by: You went down. Downed by {by}. (Eliminated in 35s unless rescued)
narrative.downed.self_unknown: You went down. (Eliminated in 35s unless rescued)
narrative.echoed.self_by: Your body has fallen — but you remain as an Echo. ({by} downed you.) You'll return when the blast comes.
narrative.echoed.self_unknown: Your body has fallen — but you remain as an Echo. You'll return when the blast comes.
narrative.echoed.witness: {player} went down and became an Echo.
narrative.eliminated.self_by: You've been eliminated. {by} finished you off.
narrative.eliminated.self_zone: You've been eliminated. The blockade zone swallowed you.
narrative.eliminated.self_timeout: You've been eliminated. No one came to save you.
narrative.eliminated.broadcast_zone: {player} has been eliminated (died in the blockade zone). {aliveCount} remain.
narrative.echo_returned.self: The blast reshaped the world — you're back. (HP {hp}, gained {insights} Insight — the fuller the memory, the fuller the reshaping)
narrative.search.empty: You search around and find nothing.
narrative.credits.reward: There was cash in the loot. (+¢{amount})
narrative.recovery.bandage: You wrap the bandage tight, and the bleeding finally stops. (HP +{hpGained})
narrative.recovery.medkit: You treat the wound and steady yourself. (HP +{hpGained})
narrative.injuryCured.leg: The wound on your leg is treated, and your steps feel light again.
narrative.injuryCured.arm: Your arm wound is bandaged tight, and you can grip your gear again.
narrative.recovery.healthy_food: You tear open the whole ration; your stomach finally has some weight in it. (HP +{hpGained}, Stamina +{staminaGained})
narrative.recovery.spoiled_food: You choke down the spoiled food. It fills your stomach, but your gut starts churning. (Stamina +{staminaGained}, discomfort for {seconds}s)
narrative.got_lost.foldback: You circled around and ended up back where you started.
narrative.got_lost.detour: You took a wrong turn. Ahead isn't {intended} — it's {actual}.
narrative.armor_broken.self: Your {item} cracked, blocking that last hit for you.
narrative.weapon_broken.salvaged: {item} broke in your hands. You gather the scrap it left behind.
narrative.weapon_broken.dropped: {item} broke in your hands. The scrap lands at your feet.
combat.block.no_item: You are not carrying that weapon.
combat.block.no_ammo: You are out of light ammo.
narrative.hide.success: You slip into cover and hold your breath.
narrative.hide.fail: You tried to hide, but couldn't find good cover.
narrative.hazard.slip_self: Your foot slips, and you stumble a few steps.
narrative.hazard.electric_self: You step into charged water! (-{damage} HP, staggered)
narrative.hazard.electric_witness: {player} got shocked, an arc bursting across the water.
narrative.hazard.revealed: A live cable was hidden under the water at {node} — now you can see it.
narrative.injury.slip: You slip and twist your leg.
narrative.injury.shock: A current surges through you, and your arm goes numb.
narrative.cache.dropped: {owner}'s supplies are scattered on the ground.
narrative.cache.dropped_priority: {owner}'s supplies are scattered on the ground (you have priority pickup for 15 seconds).
narrative.blockade.preview: ALERT: {node} is about to be sealed off. (countdown {countdown})
narrative.reset.started: Red Root is overloading — the big blast has begun. Choose what you'll carry through.
narrative.reset.completed: The world redraws itself through the roots. Old paths collapse; new ones open.
narrative.oath.broken_contact: You fired on a figure — and it was one of your own kind. The oath is broken. (Signal +15)
narrative.oath.broken: You struck one of your own kind. The oath is broken. (Signal +15)
narrative.oath.restored: At the Last Farm, you redeemed your oath.
narrative.final_reckoning: The final reckoning has begun. Nowhere left to hide. (All Signal ≥40)
narrative.sudden_death: The forest lights its last fire: nowhere to hide, no road back, only the Rootheart remains. (Signal maxed)
narrative.encounter.started_sneak: As you creep along, {targets} comes into view. (Engage/Observe/Keep moving, {seconds}s)
narrative.encounter.continued: You keep low and press on.
narrative.encounter.engaged: You raise your weapon and close in.
narrative.encounter.lost_sight: The figure melts into the terrain and is gone.
narrative.encounter.timeout: The encounter fizzles out — the road is still long.
narrative.echo_attuned: You gather a thread of calamity echo. (Intel {intel}/{target})
narrative.finale.offer_self: You open the circuit of memory at the Rootheart, waiting for companions. (20s, needs 2–3 people)
narrative.finale.offer_broadcast: {initiator} opened the circuit at the Rootheart, calling for companions. (Return the memory, 20s)
narrative.finale.joined_self: You've connected your own memory into the circuit. ({count}/3)
narrative.finale.channel_solo_self: You lay your hands on the Rootheart and begin taking everything it holds. (30s — injury, movement, or being downed forfeits it all)
narrative.finale.channel_arbora_self: The circuit closes — you begin returning memory to the tree together. (45s, protect each other)
narrative.finale.channel_arbora_broadcas: {players} began the ritual of returning memory. (45s)
narrative.finale.interrupted_outsider_br: {interruptor} tore apart the Rootheart's ritual. (Rootheart silent for 20s)
narrative.finale.interrupted_pain: Pain tears through your focus — the ritual breaks.
narrative.finale.interrupted_withdraw: You pull your hands back, and the circuit falls apart.
narrative.finale.interrupted_timeout: No one answered, and the circuit closed on its own. (Rootheart silent for 20s)
narrative.finale.interrupted_ritual: The circuit was missing what it needed and fell apart on its own — it needs someone who has walked the city, and someone carrying enough echo. (Rootheart silent for 20s)
narrative.finale.interrupted_default: The Rootheart's light dims — the ritual is interrupted. (Rootheart silent for 20s)
narrative.finale.claimed_self: The Rootheart pulses in your grasp — survive 60 seconds and everything is yours. (Signal maxed, your position revealed to everyone)
narrative.finale.claimed_broadcast: {winner} has claimed the Rootheart! Stop them within 60 seconds, or the world belongs to them. (Their position is revealed)
narrative.finale.completed_solo: Everything of the Rootheart floods into him. The forest falls silent.
narrative.finale.completed_arbora: Memory returns to the tree, and it takes them in.
narrative.finale.interruptor_appeared: Someone has seized the circuit and is tearing it open! (6s)
narrative.finale.interruptor_gone: The hand tearing at the circuit lets go — the ritual continues.
narrative.match_ended.none: No one won — the forest reclaimed everything.
narrative.match_ended.finale_solo_self: You claimed the Rootheart. From now on, the forest listens to you. (Solo Survivor)
narrative.match_ended.finale_solo_broadc: {winner} claimed the Rootheart; the forest has a new master.
narrative.match_ended.finale_coop_self: You returned the memory to the tree together. Arbora will remember you. (Covenant)
narrative.match_ended.finale_coop_broadc: {winners} made a covenant with the tree; the world welcomes a new dawn.
narrative.match_ended.tiebreak_self: The forest counted every scar — and it kept you.
narrative.match_ended.tiebreak_broadcast: The forest counted the scars, and kept {winner}.
narrative.visible.distant: You spot {player} in the distance, at {node}.
narrative.limping.seen: That figure is dragging a leg as it walks.

arbora.fallback.oath: NO ONE LEFT BEHIND. The oath binds the commune, not everyone.
